storyCards.headline: Don't Let The Sun Go Down On Me: The Performance That Defined It
storyCards.fact:
Elton John's "Don't Let The Sun Go Down On Me" reached #2 on the Billboard Hot 100.

The song peaked at #2 on the Billboard Hot 100 and spent 15 weeks on the chart.

Graph compilation anchor: "Greatest Hits" (1974) — not the song's original release year.

"Don't Let The Sun Go Down On Me" by Elton John.
